notes.title: Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hi Treasure Hunters![/b][/h1]

As always, we are [b]grateful[/b] for your reviews. Thanks to your [b]opinions and suggestions[/b], we’re able to [b]improve our game[/b] and solve problems [b]for you[/b]!

[h3][b]Keep them coming![/b][/h3]

Today, we’re excited to announce the [b]Next Update[/b] for [b]My Museum: Treasure Hunter[/b]. We hope these changes will enhance your adventure and make your experience even better!

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved lighting in Egypt
[*] Changes to missions sequence in Egypt
[*] Small fixes to saving missions in Egypt
[*] Fixed an issue where you can encounter a blocker on the tutorial mission with trash bags
[*] Fixed an issue where you can encounter a blocker while clicking on the computer
[*] Fixed an issue where your game paused while using the exhibition menu
[*] Fixed the indicator on the hook (mummy room in Egypt)
[*] Fixed an issue where you could fall off from Egypt because the landscape disappeared
[/list]

[h3][b]IMPORTANT!
For anyone having troubles with the game, especially if you played earlier playtest/demo or prologue versions. It is possible that the problem is related to the game save files from earlier versions. Try deleting the /Appdata/Local/MyMuseum/Saved folder. [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833710/My_Museum_Treasure_Hunter/

notes.title: Day One Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hi Treasure Hunters![/b][/h1]

As always - we are [b]grateful[/b] for your reviews. Thanks to your [b]opinions and suggestions[/b], we’re able to [b]improve our game[/b] and solve problems [b]for you[/b]!

[h3][b]Keep them coming![/b][/h3]

Today, we’re excited to announce the [b]Day One Patch Update[/b] for [b]My Museum: Treasure Hunter[/b]. We hope these changes will enhance your adventure and make your experience even better!

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
[list]
-Motion blur - Replaced TAA with FXAA antialiasing
-Added arrows key bindings for movement
-Translated missing words
-Fixed an issue with missing resolution screens
-Fixed an issue where you can occur blocker while using city item
-Fixed an issue where games change your language automatically
-Fixed an issue where you can skip torch riddle with using savegame 
-Fixed an issue where you can skip scarab riddle with using savegame
-Fixed an issue where you can skip mirror mini-game with using savegame
-Fixed an issue where you got first museum without needed items to progress game
-Fixed an issue where you was able to change AZERTY on French flag but you can't revert it
[/list]
[h3][b]IMPORTANT!
For anyone that have troubles with the game and you was playing earlier playtest/demo or prologue. It is possible that the problem is related to the game save files from earlier versions. Try deleting the /Appdata/Local/MyMuseum/Saved folder. [/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833710/My_Museum_Treasure_Hunter/

notes.title: New find - The release date window🤠
notes.notes:
[h2]An historical date[/h2]

Hi Treasure Hunters,

You found a new artefact, the [b]new announcement trailer of My Museum: Treasure Hunter[/b], and not only is it a work of art, it [b]features the release month[/b] of your favorite game. As you go deeper into the pyramid you can decipher a date, [b]which is surprisingly close![/b]


[previewyoutube=lhOspb7zEZQ;full][/previewyoutube]


So get ready, prepare your skills as a [b]museum director and as an adventurer, because in June you'll need them more than ever![/b]


[u]TRY THE GAME[/u] 

[b]My Museum: Treasure Hunter Prologue is still available[/b], it gives you access to an early part of the game to try it out ! 

See you soon, & take care !

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Museum Workers![/i]

Thank you for your feedback! We still work to make My Museum better and better, so it's time to give you some improvements!

[i]What can you expect?[/i]
[list]
[*] Workshop menu is no longer closing before we finish our Brewster stuff
[*] You can now carry more than one trash bag
[*] Tool is not jumping like crazy when you miss your antique with it
[*] Renovation VFX
[*] Fixed some translations
[*] New Torch-Tunnel helpers
[*] New Torch "lighting"
[*] New end-game "Mirror" implementation

[/list]
[b]Work, work![/b]

notes.notes:

New feature will be also included in My Museum Prologue. Design, create, clean and destroy!

[i]What can you expect?[/i]
[list]
[*] New exhibition mode (Top-Down View)!
[*] Break down and throw away old garbage
[*] Showcase Shop
[*] Earn money, unlock new stuff, buy more and GROW!
[/list]
